engines.name: Puck
engines.responsibility: Autoría visual React: composición, Slots/nesting, Fields, Outline, Preview, permissions, history/viewports/theming cuando la API pública lo soporte.
engines.stability: stable-core; Puck AI beta/preview and excluded from AI ownership
engines.boundary: ElectroCraft aporta modelo canónico, adapters, UX y compilación; no reconstruye editor visual, árbol de outline, nesting ni history de Puck. Puck AI no es la arquitectura AI.

engines.name: shadcn/ui + Radix
engines.responsibility: Primitivas y componentes del Studio con código poseído por el proyecto; Radix es la base elegida.
engines.stability: stable; Base UI is the July 2026 default for new projects, while Radix remains fully supported and must be selected explicitly
engines.boundary: No mezclar Base UI y Radix en la misma base de componentes. ElectroCraft puede adaptar estilos/alta densidad, no crear un segundo sistema de primitives.

engines.name: AI Elements
engines.responsibility: Componentes visuales seleccionados para superficies AI.
engines.boundary: Solo UI. No posee modelos, tools, memoria, transporte ni Draft/Apply.

engines.name: i18next
engines.responsibility: Catálogo i18n, resolución de idioma y fallback.
engines.boundary: Fallback visible del Studio en español; no mantener un catálogo paralelo.

engines.name: react-i18next
engines.responsibility: Binding React para i18next y workflow tipado en UI.
engines.boundary: No reemplaza i18next; solo binding React.

engines.name: PGlite
engines.responsibility: Postgres WASM local para Internal Data y persistencia local; Worker compartido para multi-tab cuando aplique.
engines.stability: stable APIs; browser worker integration requires target validation
engines.boundary: Es storage/runtime local, no modelo canónico de datos ni motor de sync inventado por ElectroCraft.

engines.name: Drizzle ORM
engines.responsibility: Schema/query/migrations tipadas sobre stores SQL soportados, incluido PGlite.
engines.boundary: No crear ORM/migration DSL paralelo.

engines.name: Refine
engines.responsibility: Orquestación de Administración: resources, providers, CRUD/admin composition.
engines.boundary: Solo Administración; no posee query cache, table engine, form state, validation ni modelos de datos canónicos.

engines.name: TanStack Query
engines.responsibility: Único cache/estado asíncrono de server/query data en React.
engines.boundary: No crear segundo query cache en Refine, stores o adapters.

engines.name: TanStack Table
engines.responsibility: Motor headless de tablas, sorting/filtering/pagination state.
engines.stability: v8 remains the latest stable line; v9 is beta and requires the @beta dist-tag, so Core must not adopt v9 implicitly
engines.boundary: TanStack Table owns headless table state/algorithms. ElectroCraft/Refine composes UI above it; v9 beta requires an explicit future pin/ADR and no parallel table/CSV engine is allowed.

engines.name: React Hook Form
engines.responsibility: Estado, registro, validación orchestration y submission de forms React.
engines.boundary: No crear form-state engine paralelo.

engines.name: Zod
engines.responsibility: Schemas y validación runtime/TypeScript para contratos ElectroCraft.
engines.boundary: Una schema source por contrato; adapters consumen schema, no duplican validadores.

engines.name: React Query Builder
engines.responsibility: Autoría acotada de condiciones/filtros lógicos.
engines.boundary: No es workflow engine ni query-cache; produce/edita condiciones canónicas.

engines.name: Rete
engines.responsibility: Grafo visual y procesamiento de workflows; dataflow/control-flow según plugins/APIs.
engines.boundary: Rete posee graph editing/processing; ElectroCraft mapea Actions/Workflow canonical model y runtime/export semantics.

engines.name: Tiptap
engines.responsibility: Rich-text editor y representación JSON/HTML renderable.
engines.stability: stable core; paid/pro extensions excluded unless separately approved
engines.boundary: Un único formato rich-text canónico; no editor paralelo.

engines.name: Zustand
engines.responsibility: Estado runtime/client local y stores explícitos.
engines.boundary: No usar Zustand como query-cache ni base de datos; persistir solo slices declarados.

engines.name: Vercel AI SDK
engines.responsibility: Orquestación AI de aplicación: generación, streaming, structured output y tool calling.
engines.boundary: AI siempre escribe Draft; Apply explícito. No mutación directa del documento.

engines.name: AI SDK Google provider
engines.responsibility: Provider adapter de Gemini para AI SDK.
engines.boundary: Provider, no segundo AI orchestration layer.

engines.name: Google Gen AI SDK
engines.responsibility: SDK oficial Google para APIs Gemini específicas no cubiertas por la abstracción AI SDK.
engines.stability: stable SDK; individual APIs/models may be preview
engines.boundary: Usar solo detrás de servicio AI/secret refs; nunca exponer API keys en cliente/export.

engines.name: Gemini Interactions API
engines.responsibility: Interacciones/stateful workflows de Gemini cuando el API y modelo elegido lo soporten.
engines.stability: GA in Gemini API v1 since June 2026; v1beta remains available for preview features and individual models/agents can still be preview
engines.boundary: Use stable API v1 for the GA lane via @google/genai when this Google-specific capability is needed; do not make server-side interaction state canonical ElectroCraft storage. Preview models/agents stay capability-gated.

engines.name: Gemini image generation
engines.responsibility: Generación/edición de imagen AI mediante modelos Gemini compatibles.
engines.stability: model-dependent; preview/stable status follows model catalog
engines.boundary: Modelo configurable/capability-gated; assets entran al Draft antes de Apply.

engines.name: Expo SDK
engines.responsibility: Runtime/toolchain nativo para targets Android/iOS Expo.
engines.stability: stable SDK releases; experimental APIs individually gated
engines.boundary: Solo targets nativos Expo; web runtime sigue independiente.

engines.name: Expo Router
engines.responsibility: File-based/native navigation shell de export Expo.
engines.boundary: Compila Navigation/Routes canónico; no se vuelve el owner canónico.

engines.name: Expo SQLite
engines.responsibility: Persistencia SQLite nativa para exports Expo cuando capability mapping lo requiera.
engines.stability: native stable; web support is alpha and must remain capability-gated
engines.boundary: Adapter target-specific, no reemplaza Data Source canonical model.

engines.name: Lucide
engines.responsibility: Iconografía consistente web/native.
engines.boundary: Assets/icons only; no UI component system paralelo.

engines.name: Apache ECharts
engines.responsibility: Charts web y renderizado web/export compatible cuando aplique.
engines.boundary: Charts web; no asumir soporte React Native.

engines.name: Victory Native
engines.responsibility: Charts para exports React Native.
engines.stability: stable library; native peer stack must be validated with Expo baseline
engines.boundary: Charts nativos; no duplicar chart semantics canónicas.

engines.name: FullCalendar Standard
engines.responsibility: Calendario web estándar.
engines.boundary: Solo Standard OSS salvo decisión separada; premium no entra por accidente.

engines.name: react-native-calendars
engines.responsibility: Calendarios React Native para targets Expo.
engines.boundary: Adaptador visual nativo, no modelo canónico de eventos.

engines.name: dnd-kit
packages: legacy @dnd-kit/core only where an owning phase explicitly pins it
engines.responsibility: Drag/drop accesible para interacciones del Studio fuera de las superficies que Puck ya posee.
engines.stability: active package/API transition: current docs provide @dnd-kit/react and an explicit migration guide from legacy @dnd-kit/core
engines.boundary: Use only for Studio interactions outside Puck-owned canvas/nesting/outline. The owning POC must pin either the new React architecture or a justified legacy surface; do not mix both casually.

verifiedPackageObservations.drizzle-orm: 0.45.2 stable; 1.0 RC is not the default stable lane
verifiedPackageObservations.expo-sdk: latest docs expose SDK 57 compatibility table; exact workspace tuple is reverified at F22/F23 install time
